note: Hand-reviewed approvals and guidance. The weekly updater adds literature to advances.json; it never edits this file.

items.title: Target product profiles for new antibacterial agents
items.body: Sets out what new agents still need to do: severe MDR Gram-negatives, high-risk Gram-positives and bacterial meningitis.

items.title: Breakpoint tables v16.0: gepotidacin added, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole revised
items.body: UTI teaching points and the TMP-SMX card should use the 2026 breakpoint language.

items.title: Zoliflodacin and gepotidacin approved for uncomplicated gonorrhoea
items.body: Two oral first-in-class options for a pathogen where ceftriaxone has been the last reliable single agent.

items.title: Clinical antibacterial pipeline fell from 97 to 90 candidates
items.body: Gaps flagged in paediatric formulations, oral outpatient options and combination strategies.

items.title: Gepotidacin (Blujepa) approved for uncomplicated UTI
items.body: A new oral mechanism for cystitis that can spare fluoroquinolones and TMP-SMX.

items.title: AMR Gram-negative guidance: identify the carbapenemase before choosing the β-lactam/inhibitor
items.body: KPC, OXA-48 and NDM need different agents. Aztreonam with avibactam and cefiderocol are the metallo-β-lactamase options.

items.title: AWaRe classification 2023
items.body: The Access, Watch and Reserve groups shown on every antibacterial card in this app.
